R notebook for analyses associated with results section 'Timing of colibactin mutagenesis' in Marshall et al. Common early-life exposure of the colorectal epithelium to the microbiome-derived mutagen colibactin

```{r}
library(ape)
library(dplyr)
library(ggtree)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
```

```{r}
crypt_signature_attributions<-read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')
```

## a : construct pileup to facilitate timing analysis:
```{r compute_branch_sens}
## compute_branch_sens computes per branch sensitivities based off coverage and median vaf
compute_branch_sens <- function(tree, tip_sens) {
  Ntip  <- Ntip(tree)
  Nnode <- tree$Nnode
  sens <- rep(NA_real_, Ntip + Nnode)
  
  # match tip sensitivities to tip order
  sens[1:Ntip] <- tip_sens[tree$tip.label,]
  
  po <- reorder.phylo(tree, "postorder")
  edges <- po$edge
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(edges))) {
    parent <- edges[i, 1]
    children <- edges[edges[,1] == parent, 2]
    
    if (all(!is.na(sens[children]))) {
      sens[parent] <- 1 - prod(1 - sens[children])
    }
  }
  return(sens)  # named by node index implicitly
}

```

```{r construct pileup of nodes for each crypt}
##
tip_sens<-crypt_signature_attributions%>%
  dplyr::select(crypt, sensitivitySBS)%>%
  column_to_rownames(var='crypt')

# initiate a data frame for crypt pileup
dir='../Phylogenetic_Trees/'
patients=list.files(dir)
crypt_pileup=NULL
sens_edge_compiled=NULL

for (patient in patients){
  if (file.exists(paste0(dir,patient,"/Patient_snv_tree_with_branch_length.tree"))){
  tree = read.tree(paste0(dir,patient,"/Patient_snv_tree_with_branch_length.tree"))
  
  # adjust branch lengths for sensitivity :
  sens_vec <- compute_branch_sens(tree, tip_sens)
  sens_df <- data.frame(node = seq_along(sens_vec),sens = sens_vec)
  edge_df <- as.data.frame(tree$edge)
  
  colnames(edge_df) <- c("parent", "child")
  edge_df <- merge(edge_df, sens_df,  by.x = "child", by.y = "node",  all.x = TRUE)%>%
    mutate(sens=replace_na(sens,1))
  edge_df$Samples=paste0(patient,'_',edge_df$child)
  sens_edge_compiled<-rbind(sens_edge_compiled,edge_df)

  tree_df=ggtree::fortify(tree)
  
  # pile up branches for each crypt :
  crypts=unique(tree_df$label)
  crypts=crypts[!is.na(crypts)]
  crypts=crypts[str_detect(crypts,'PD')]
  for (n in 1:length(crypts)){
    crypt=crypts[n]
    
    end_branch=tree_df[tree_df$label==crypt&!is.na(tree_df$label),]
    branch_pileup=end_branch
    branch=end_branch
    while (branch$node!=branch$parent){
      new_node=branch$parent
      new_branch=tree_df[tree_df$node==new_node,]
      branch_pileup<-rbind(branch_pileup,new_branch)
      branch=new_branch
    }
    branch_pileup$crypt=crypt
  
  crypt_pileup=rbind(crypt_pileup,branch_pileup)
  }
  } else { crypt_pileup= crypt_pileup }
}


crypt_pileup$patient=str_extract(crypt_pileup$crypt,'PD\\d{5}')
crypt_pileup$biopsy=str_extract(crypt_pileup$crypt,'PD\\d{5}\\w')
crypt_pileup$branch_id=paste(crypt_pileup$patient,crypt_pileup$node,sep="_")
crypt_pileup<-crypt_pileup%>%filter(!duplicated(paste0(crypt,branch_id)))
sens_edge_compiled<-sens_edge_compiled%>% dplyr::select(-parent,-child)
```

## b : construct a dataframe for timing analysis
### i : adjust mutational signature attributions for the sensitivity for each branch
```{r}
## load in signature attribution to each branch branches attribution :
msa_branches<-read.csv('../Signatures/MSA_Attribution/pruned_attribution_paediatric_branches_SBS_abs_mutations.csv')%>%
  rename_with(.,~paste0(.x,'_branch'))

## construct a dataframe with signature attributions adjusted :
crypt_branch<-crypt_pileup %>% dplyr::select(biopsy, crypt, branch_id)
signature_attributions_compiled<-left_join(crypt_branch,msa_branches,by=c('branch_id'='X_branch')) %>%
  left_join(sens_edge_compiled,by=c('branch_id'='Samples'))%>%
  mutate(sens=replace_na(sens,1))%>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(.x,0)))%>%
  mutate(across(contains('SBS'),~round(.x,digits=3)),
         across(contains('SBS'), ~.x / sens))
```

### ii : annotate the branches with sbs signature counts
```{r }
## begin with the crypt pileup and combine with the attributions df :
crypt_pileup_sig_annotated<-left_join(x=crypt_pileup, y=signature_attributions_compiled, by=c('biopsy','crypt','branch_id'))
positive_biopsies<-crypt_signature_attributions%>%
  dplyr::select(biopsy,biopsy_colibactin_pos,patient_colibactin_pos)%>%
  unique()

crypt_pileup_sig_annotated<-left_join(crypt_pileup_sig_annotated,positive_biopsies,by='biopsy')

#crypt_pileup_sig_annotated_current_results <-crypt_pileup_sig_annotated  
## load in patient metadata
age_df=crypt_metadata%>%dplyr::select(patient,age)%>%unique()
colnames(age_df)<-c('patient','Age')

## construct a dataframe for creating relevant data time points :
crypt_pileup_sig_annotated=crypt_pileup_sig_annotated%>%
  
  # zero truncal mutations :
  mutate(across(contains("SBS"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)), # these are typically the root branches 
    muts_assigned=rowSums(pick(contains('_branch'))),
    across(contains('_branch'),~ifelse(muts_assigned>branch.length,(.x/muts_assigned)*branch.length,.x)),
    across(contains("_branch"),~ if_else(branch.length <= 50 & x<50, 0, .x)),
         SBSUnassigned = branch.length - rowSums(pick(contains('_branch'))))%>%
  
  arrange(crypt, x)%>%
  group_by(crypt)%>%
  
  # calculate the background mutaitons for a given branch
  mutate(background_muts_branch = SBS1_branch+SBS5_branch+SBS18_branch+SBSUnassigned) %>%
  
  # calculcate the total background mutations for the start and end points of a branch 
  mutate(background_muts_branch_end_msa  = cumsum(background_muts_branch),
         background_muts_branch_start_msa = background_muts_branch_end_msa - background_muts_branch) %>%
  
  
  # calculate the total mutations for the end of the branch and total background mutation for a crypt
  mutate(all_muts_count_branch_end_msa = cumsum(background_muts_branch + SBS88_branch),
         background_muts_crypt_total_msa = sum(background_muts_branch)) %>%
  ungroup() 
```

create confidence intervals for the breakpoints in each phylogenetic trees
to create confidence intervals, we perform a poisson test for the number of brackground
mutations preceding that branch point against the total number of mutations for that crypt
```{r}
## create confidence intervals :
branch_end_ci_mat<-t(mapply(function(x,n){
  pt=poisson.test(round(x,digits=0),round(n,digits=0))
  conf.intv=pt$conf.int * n},
  x=crypt_pileup_sig_annotated$background_muts_branch_end_msa,
  n=crypt_pileup_sig_annotated$background_muts_crypt_total_msa))

colnames(branch_end_ci_mat)<-c('background_muts_branch_end_lower_ci','background_muts_branch_end_upper_ci')

branch_start_ci_mat<-t(mapply(function(x,n){
  pt=poisson.test(round(x,digits=0),round(n,digits=0))
  conf.intv=pt$conf.int * n},
x=crypt_pileup_sig_annotated$background_muts_branch_start_msa,
n=crypt_pileup_sig_annotated$background_muts_crypt_total_msa))

colnames(branch_start_ci_mat)<-c('background_muts_branch_start_lower_ci','background_muts_branch_start_upper_ci')

crypt_pileup_sig_annotated<-cbind(crypt_pileup_sig_annotated,branch_start_ci_mat,branch_end_ci_mat)
```

determine per crypt rates of background mutations
```{r}
## select age for each biopsy
age_df<-unique(subset(crypt_metadata,names=c('biopsy','age')))

## determine background mutation rates
background_mut_rates<-crypt_pileup_sig_annotated%>%
  dplyr::select(biopsy,crypt,background_muts_crypt_total_msa)%>%
  unique()%>%
  left_join(.,age_df,by=c('biopsy'='biopsy'))%>%
  mutate(background_muts_rate_msa=background_muts_crypt_total_msa/age)%>%
  dplyr::select(crypt,background_muts_rate_msa,age)
```

### iii: Extract data for estimated beginnings of exposure
```{r}
#### 1. extract the timepoints for latest possible commencement per crypt : ----
# extract the timepoints for latest timepoint of commencement per crypt
commencement_time_points_msa <- crypt_pileup_sig_annotated %>%
  
  # subset positive branches :
  filter(SBS88_branch > 0) %>%
  group_by(crypt)%>%
  
  # determine ealiest branch :
  summarise(across(c(contains('background_muts_branch_end'),all_muts_count_branch_end_msa),~min(.x,na.rm=TRUE),.names='{.col}_min'))%>%
  mutate(patient_id = str_extract(crypt, "PD\\d{5}")) %>%
  
  # joinst with mutation rtes.
  left_join(background_mut_rates, by = "crypt") %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with('_min'), ~.x/background_muts_rate_msa,.names = "age_{.col}"),
         mutational_age_end_first_pos_branch = all_muts_count_branch_end_msa_min / background_muts_rate_msa) %>%
  
  # if a crypt does not bifurcate, it's the age_background_muts_branch_end_msa_min will equal age, these must be removed
  filter(round(age, 3) != round(age_background_muts_branch_end_msa_min, 3)) %>%
  
  # select earliest timepoint for a given bifurcation:
  group_by(background_muts_branch_end_msa_min) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with('age_'),~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  
  # select columns to keep
  dplyr::select(patient_id, crypt, contains('age_background_muts_branch_end'))

colnames(commencement_time_points_msa)=str_replace(colnames(commencement_time_points_msa),'background_muts_branch_end','latest_crypt_commencement')

#### 2. extract the timepoints for earliest timepoint of per individual :-------
# extract the timepoints for earliest timepoint of per individual
start_commencement_time_points_msa <- crypt_pileup_sig_annotated %>%
  
  # subset colibactin positive branches
  filter(SBS88_branch > 0) %>%
  group_by(crypt) %>%
  # determine ealiest branch :
  summarise(across(contains('background_muts_branch_start'),~min(.x,na.rm=TRUE),.names='{.col}_min'),.groups = "drop")%>%
  
  # determine age at branch points :
  left_join(background_mut_rates, by = "crypt") %>%
  mutate(across(contains('_min'),~.x / background_muts_rate_msa,.names='age_{.col}'))%>%
  
  # once again select branch point with earlier age :
  group_by(background_muts_branch_start_msa_min) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with('age_'),~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(crypt)%>%
  
  # if there were no preceding mutations, we exclude these :
  filter(age_background_muts_branch_start_msa_min > 0) %>%
  summarise(across(contains('age_background_muts_branch_start'),~min(.x,na.rm=TRUE)),.groups = "drop")

# rename column names
colnames(start_commencement_time_points_msa)=str_replace(colnames(start_commencement_time_points_msa),'background_muts_branch_start','crypt_earliest_commencement')

#### 3. extract the timepoints of known ongoing exposure :---------------------
#Timepoints of ongoing exposure are identified by two sequential positive branches.
## extract the timepoints for continuation of exposure
known_pos_timepoints_msa<-crypt_pileup_sig_annotated %>%
  
  # subset positive branches :
  filter(SBS88_branch > 0) %>%
  
  # identify instances where a second positive branch is observed
  group_by(crypt) %>%
  mutate(pos_branches=cumsum(SBS88_branch > 0))%>%
  filter(pos_branches > 1) %>% # subset second positive branch only
  
  # determine age at commencement of a branch :
  summarise(across(contains('background_muts_branch_start'), ~round(min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),digits=2)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(patient_id = str_extract(crypt, "PD\\d{5}")) %>%
  left_join(background_mut_rates, by = "crypt") %>%
  mutate(across(contains('background_muts_branch_start'), ~.x/ background_muts_rate_msa,.names='age_{.col}')) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, crypt, contains('background_muts_branch_start'))%>%
  
  # finally determine earliest age for a time point :
  group_by(background_muts_branch_start_msa)%>%
  mutate(across(contains('age_background_muts_branch_start'),~min(.x,na.rm=TRUE)))%>%ungroup()%>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id,crypt,contains('age'))

# rename column names
colnames(known_pos_timepoints_msa)=str_replace(colnames(known_pos_timepoints_msa),'background_muts_branch_start','known_pos_timepoint')

#### 4. extract the timepoints of cessation of exposure per crypt :-------------
## extract the timepoints of cessation of exposure per crypt :
cessation_timepoints_msa <- crypt_pileup_sig_annotated %>%
  
  # identify negative branches that follow positive branches
  group_by(crypt) %>%
  filter((cumsum(SBS88_branch > 0) > 0) & # branches where there is at least a preceding positive branch
           SBS88_branch == 0) %>% # select neg branches 
  
  # because it will return every colibactin neg branch, select the earliest age
  summarise(across(contains('background_muts_branch_start'), ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(patient_id = str_extract(crypt, "PD\\d{5}")) %>%
  
  # determine age at break point :
  left_join(background_mut_rates, by = "crypt") %>%
  mutate(across(contains('background_muts_branch_start'), ~.x/ background_muts_rate_msa,.names='age_{.col}')) %>%
  group_by(background_muts_branch_start_msa)%>%
  
  # finally determine earliest age for a time point : 
  mutate(across(contains('age_background_muts_branch_start'),~min(.x,na.rm=TRUE)))%>%
  filter(!is.na(age_background_muts_branch_start_msa))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id,crypt, contains('age_')) 

# rename column names
colnames(cessation_timepoints_msa)=str_replace(colnames(cessation_timepoints_msa),'background_muts_branch_start','crypt_cessation')
```
### iv : Collate data for plotting swimmers plot
```{r}
## create dataframe of all timepoints :
crypt_timepoints_df <- crypt_pileup_sig_annotated %>%
  
  # select relevant columnts
  dplyr::select(patient, biopsy, crypt, patient_colibactin_pos,biopsy_colibactin_pos) %>%
  
  # subset positivie individuals
  filter(patient_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>%
  filter(!duplicated(crypt))%>%
  
  # add the earliest possible commencement timepoints 
  left_join(start_commencement_time_points_msa, by = c("crypt")) %>%
  
  # add the latest possible commencement timepoints 
  left_join(commencement_time_points_msa, by = c("crypt", "patient" = "patient_id")) %>%
  
  # add the timepoints of known ongoing exposure
  left_join(known_pos_timepoints_msa, by = c("crypt", "patient" = "patient_id")) %>%
  
  # add the timepoints of cessation 
  left_join(cessation_timepoints_msa, by = c("crypt", "patient" = "patient_id")) %>%
  
  # combine with background mutation rates because this has the age parameter :
  left_join(background_mut_rates, by = "crypt") %>%
  mutate(across(contains('age_latest_crypt_commencement_msa'), ~ if_else(age_latest_crypt_commencement_msa_min == age, NA_real_, .x))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_latest_crypt_commencement_msa_min))

```

Convert to long format :
```{r}
## convert to long format
crypt_timepoints_long_df<-crypt_timepoints_df %>%
  dplyr::select(patient,biopsy,age, crypt,starts_with('age_')) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=starts_with('age_'),
               names_to = c('timepoint','ci'),
               names_pattern = "age_(.*?)(?:_msa|_mmsig)?(?:_(lower_ci|upper_ci))?(?:_min)?$", 
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(ci=ifelse(ci=="",'estimate',ci), ci = coalesce(ci, "estimate"), 
         value=unlist(value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ci, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(upper_ci=ifelse(upper_ci>age,age,upper_ci))

## compute patient ordering by median age
patient_order <- crypt_timepoints_long_df %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(donor_age = median(age, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(donor_age)

## reorder patients by age :
crypt_timepoints_long_df <- crypt_timepoints_long_df %>%
  mutate(patient_f = factor(patient, levels = patient_order$patient))
crypt_timepoints_long_df<-crypt_timepoints_long_df%>%
  mutate(location=case_when(timepoint=='crypt_earliest_commencement'~'Donor',
                            str_detect(biopsy,'b')~'Right',
                            str_detect(biopsy,'c')~'Left'))
```
## c : plot swimmers plot:
### i : construct plot for cessation /continuation of exposure
```{r}
## create the swimmers plot for the timepoints of active and ceased exposure :
png('~/active_cessation_exposure.png',width=2800,height=1600,res=300, bg='transparent')

# create plot
ggplot(crypt_timepoints_long_df, aes(y = patient_f)) +
  theme_bw() +
  
  # state labels
  labs(x = 'Estimated Chronological Age at Timepoint [years]', y = 'Study Participant', color = "Event", shape = "Event") +
  
  # create a segment for each individual
  geom_segment(data = distinct(crypt_timepoints_long_df, patient_f, age), aes(x = 0, xend = age, yend = patient_f), color = "grey80", size = 2)+
  
  # annotate the 95% confidence interval for break points 
  geom_segment(data=crypt_timepoints_long_df[crypt_timepoints_long_df$timepoint %in% c('known_pos_timepoint','crypt_cessation'),], aes(x = lower_ci, y = patient_f, xend = upper_ci,linetype='95% Confidence Interval'),colour = "black",alpha=0.5)+ #adds the error bars 
  
  # annotate timepoints :
  geom_point(data=crypt_timepoints_long_df[crypt_timepoints_long_df$timepoint %in% c('known_pos_timepoint','crypt_cessation'),],
             aes(x = estimate, y = patient_f, colour='black',fill = timepoint,),  # use aes() inside geom_point
             size = 3.5, colour='black', shape=23,alpha=0.9,stroke=1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  
  
  # format the diamonds for timepoints 
  scale_fill_manual(breaks = c("known_pos_timepoint", "crypt_cessation"),
                    values = c("known_pos_timepoint" = "green4","crypt_cessation" = "orange1"),
                    labels = c("known_pos_timepoint" = "Timepoint of Active Exposure (Crypt)", "crypt_cessation" = "Latest Possible Cessation of Exposure (Crypt)")) +
  
  # format the x-axis :
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 20, 5),minor_breaks = seq(0, 20, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02)))+

  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9,face='bold',colour='black'),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12,face='bold'),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position='none',
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
  )

dev.off()
```

## c : calculate summary statistics:
```{r}
## number of individuals with informative time points :
length(unique(crypt_timepoints_long_df$patient)) # n = 23
```

determine patient level summaries for commencement of exposure :
```{r}
## summary for timings of exposure :
crypt_timepoints_long_df%>%
  group_by(patient,timepoint)%>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c('crypt_earliest_commencement','latest_crypt_commencement'))%>%
  filter(estimate==min(estimate))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,timepoint,estimate)%>%
  group_by(timepoint)%>%
  summarise(median=round(median(estimate,na.rm=T),digits=1),
            lwr=round(quantile(estimate,0.25,na.rm=T),digits=1),
            upr=round(quantile(estimate,0.75,na.rm=T),digits=1),
            min=round(min(estimate,0.75,na.rm=T),digits=1))
```

determine patient level summaries for commencement of exposure :
```{r}
## crypt level summaries
crypt_timepoints_long_df%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(!timepoint %in% c('crypt_earliest_commencement','latest_crypt_commencement'))%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,timepoint,estimate)%>%
  group_by(timepoint)%>%
  summarise(median=round(median(estimate,na.rm=T),digits=1),
            lwr=round(quantile(estimate,0.25,na.rm=T),digits=1),
            upr=round(quantile(estimate,0.75,na.rm=T),digits=1),
            min=round(min(estimate,0.75,na.rm=T),digits=1))
```

identify earliest metric for earliest possible commencement 
```{r}
# identify earliest case :
crypt_timepoints_long_df%>%filter(timepoint=='crypt_earliest_commencement')%>%
  filter(estimate==min(estimate,na.rm=T))
```

identify earliest metric for latest possible commencement :
```{r}
crypt_timepoints_long_df%>%filter(timepoint=='latest_crypt_commencement')%>%
  filter(estimate==min(estimate))
```

identify earliest instance of cessation in a crypt :
```{r}
crypt_timepoints_long_df%>%filter(timepoint=='crypt_cessation')%>%
  filter(estimate==min(estimate,na.rm=T))
```

identify latest instance of continuation in a crypt :
```{r}
crypt_timepoints_long_df%>%filter(timepoint=='known_pos_timepoint')%>%
  filter(estimate==max(estimate,na.rm=T))
```

for age ranges, stipulate the ratio of continuation to cessation :
```{r}
ages<-c(0,2,5,10,15)
for (i in 2:length(ages)){
  
  time_sum<-crypt_timepoints_long_df%>%
    filter(estimate> ages[i-1] &estimate < ages[i] & timepoint %in% c('known_pos_timepoint','crypt_cessation'))%>%
    filter(!duplicated(paste0(biopsy,estimate)))%>%
    group_by(timepoint)%>%
    summarise(n=n())%>%ungroup()%>%
    mutate(prop=n/sum(n),ratio= prop/(1-prop))
  colnames(time_sum)<-c('timepoint',paste0('n_',ages[i-1],'_',ages[i]), paste0('prop_',ages[i-1],'_',ages[i]),'ratio')
  print(time_sum)
}

```

compare the timepoints for continuation between left and right side colon :
```{r}
crypt_timepoints_long_df%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(timepoint=='known_pos_timepoint')%>%
  mutate(location=ifelse(str_detect(crypt,'c'),'Right','Left'))%>%
  group_by(location)%>%
  filter(!duplicated(estimate))%>%
  filter(!is.na(estimate))%>%
  mutate(location=factor(location,levels=c('Left','Right')))%>%

  summarise(timepoints=length(location),
            median=median(estimate, na.rm=T),
            max=max(estimate,na.rm=T),
            min=min(estimate,na.rm=T),
            lower=quantile(estimate,0.25,na.rm=T),
            upper=quantile(estimate,0.75,na.rm=T))

```
